title: Appointment Setter / SDR
description:
We’re a B2B outbound agency looking for a full-time SDR whose sole focus is keeping our funnel topped up. This is a pure outbound role — no account management, no fulfillment, nothing but pipeline generation.



Priority #1 — Handle interested leads. We run cold
 at scale (~1,500 sends/day), and interested replies come in daily. Your top priority is engaging those interested leads and booking calls. You’ll work out of our portal’s custom inbox, which makes replying fast and easy. For each interested lead, the expected cadence is:



: up to 4 follow-ups

Phone: 7 calls total (when we’re able to source a number)

LinkedIn: max 3 touchpoints, sent on behalf of one of our accounts



Priority #2 — Cold outbound. Once all interested leads are worked, you move to cold outreach from lists we provide. This means phone dialing and LinkedIn messaging only — we handle cold
 at scale, so that’s not part of your job.



Nice to have — Discovery calls. If you have prior client-facing experience or have run sales calls before, we’re open to letting you handle discovery calls (qualifying leads to see whether they fit our criteria). We’ll coach you on how we do this. No experience here? That’s fine — it’s a bonus, not a requirement.



Growth path. This role has a clear path forward: perform well and we’ll promote you to Account Executive, where you’ll close deals and earn more.



Requirements:



Near-perfect spoken English (this is non-negotiable — you’ll be on the phone with US prospects)

Able to work EST hours (our leads span EST/PST/MST)



Prior SDR / appointment-setting experience — please share examples of outbound work you’ve done before (results, tools, campaigns)



Available to start ASAP



To apply: Send a short intro, your relevant experience, and any proof of past outbound results.

Book Cover Design: Design and present 3 cover concepts per title within 1 week of receiving the brief; revise until the client is satisfied.



Book Interior Layout: Design and format book interiors in InDesign using character styles and paragraph styles.



Proof Rounds: Before proceeding to full interior design, deliver proofs of key page designs for client approval — title page, table of contents, a chapter title page, and a text spread including a pullout quote.



Turnaround: Full book layout completed within 2 weeks of brief/content handoff.



Revisions: Incorporate client feedback and handle revision rounds efficiently.



File Management: Deliver print-ready and organized files via Dropbox.





Compensation & Work Structure

Rate: $5–7/hour

Volume: Starting at 1 book/month, with potential to scale up

Project-Based: Talent pool model. Engagement occurs on a per-project basis

Flexible Remote Work: Work from your own space while coordinating with an international team.



Required Skills & Qualifications

InDesign Expert: High-level proficiency — character styles, paragraph styles, master pages, and long-document formatting are non-negotiable.



Book Design Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating book cover and interior layout work.



Branding Experience: Proven experience designing branding and marketing collateral.



Print Knowledge: Familiarity with print-ready file prep including bleeds, margins, and color profiles.



Remote Setup: Access to a high-performance computer and reliable internet.



Discretion: Total commitment to maintaining confidentiality and protecting client data.



No AI Tools: Client work must be produced without AI-assisted design, image generation, or content tools.



Nice To Have but not required

Author Branding: Build out branding packages including logos, business cards, brochures, posters, banners, and social media templates.

Website design experience using Figma



Experience designing for self-published or indie authors

title: Appointment Setter / Outbound Cold Caller (Long-Term, Base + Commission)
description:
Appointment Setter / Outbound Cold Caller (Long-Term, Base + Commission)



We are a marketing agency and we are looking for one reliable, confident appointment setter to join us long-term. This is a stable, ongoing role with real earning upside, not a short gig.



What you'll do (simple and clear): You call business owners from a list we give you and book them onto a 30-minute call with our founder. That's it. You do not sell anything and you do not quote any prices. You qualify them against a short checklist and you book the call. Our founder does all the closing.



We make this easy for you:



We give you the full list every week (business name, owner's name, phone number, and a one-line hook for each). You never have to find your own leads.

We give you the full call script, the answers to every common objection, and text/email templates.

We give you recordings of our founder's own calls so you can hear exactly how it's done.

You dial through our system (GoHighLevel) with a local phone number, so your calls show up as a local call.

Your day:



Make around 150 to 200 dials per day in focused blocks.

Follow our simple 6-step script: greet, give the reason for the call, ask 3 quick questions, book the slot, confirm by text.

Log the result of every single call in our CRM. This is very important. No call goes unlogged.

Send a confirmation text within 5 minutes of every booking, plus a reminder on the morning of the call.

Send one short end-of-day report: dials, connections, conversations, booked, held.

The number that matters: held calls, meaning the people who actually show up to the call. We want a steady 5 or more held calls a week. We will train and support you to get there.



Who we want:



Excellent, clear, confident spoken English. You sound warm and natural on the phone, not scripted.

Real experience with outbound cold calling or appointment setting (US, UK, Canada, or Australia markets is a big plus).

Thick skin and consistency. You can make 150+ dials a day and keep your energy up.

You are disciplined and you log every call, every time.

Reliable internet, a good headset, and a quiet place to work.

Experience with GoHighLevel or any dialler/CRM is a plus (we will train you on ours).

Pay:



Monthly base salary (paid reliably every month), PLUS

Commission: 7.5% of the recurring revenue on every deal you book that closes, paid every month for the entire life of that client. This is where the real money is. Book good clients that stay, and your monthly income keeps growing on top of your base. There is no cap.

A deal is yours if you booked the call and it closes within 45 days.

The right person here earns far more than a normal setter salary because you keep earning from every client you bring in, month after month.



Hours: We work Irish and North American business hours. Please only apply if you can work reliably during those hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do these three things. Applications that skip any of them will be ignored:



Start your message with the words "I DIAL TO WIN" so I know you actually read this post.

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager| 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.



You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented - and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.



Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.



If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems - and you're just as comfortable doing the daily operational grind as you are building the systems - keep reading.



What You'll Do:

-Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

-Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

-Be the team's first point of contact for day-to-day questions and blockers - not the founders

-Chase deadlines directly with tea
mbers and follow up when tasks haven't been updated

-Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly, resolving small cross-department friction points without escalating

-Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

-Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

-Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

-Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

-Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

-Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

-Track and report operational KPIs and cost trends, flagging profitability signals for the founders' review

-Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

-Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

-Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Where the Founders Stay Involved

To be clear about where this role starts and stops: the Founders will continue to own overall company direction and priorities; brand, product, and market strategy; final decisions on launches, positioning, and pricing; approval of budgets, salaries, hiring/firing, and major investments; and review of high-level KPIs and reports.



This role owns everything else: the daily execution, systems, and team accountability that make those strategic decisions possible - including the follow-up, reminders, and day-to-day problem-solving that used to fall on the founders.



Tools You Must Know:

-ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

-Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

-Slack or similar - team communication

-Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

-Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



-3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

-You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

-You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

-You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

-You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

-You're energized by the operational grind, not just the systems and dashboards, because that's most of what this role actually is day to day

-Excellent English, written and verbal

-Familiarity with Amazon tools

-You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

-$1,800-$2,000/month based on experience

-Full-time, 40h/week

-14 days paid leave after 3 months

-First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

-Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

-Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

-Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

-Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. 



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your  one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?





Please also include your salary expectation and availability.

title: DaVinci Resolve Colorist for Wedding Films (Ongoing, Per-Film)

Delivery is 1 week from the day I send the project. One round of revisions

after my notes, turned around in 2 days.



FILES



The first film will be sent WITHOUT proxies. It is roughly 650GB. You need

internet that can actually download that, and the drive space to hold it.



Every film after the first will be sent with proxies, so the transfers will

be much smaller.



WHO I WANT



You must already be experienced with DaVinci Resolve. I do not have time to

teach the software. You should be comfortable with node trees, shot matching,

power windows, and grading log footage. No lazy copy pasting clips and not adjusting them. I've had too many times a mask was in the wrong position or colors/exposure were off because the editor didn't take the time to refine each shot.

title: Merchandise Planner - Retail Apparel & Footwear (Womens Fashion)
description:
Location: Sydney, Australia (Remote)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 5:00pm

Remuneration: US$350 pw, paid each Friday



About the Role



We're looking for a commercially minded Merchandise Planner to join our Planning team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into action, working closely with Buying, Retail Operations and Logistics to maximise sales, margin and inventory productivity.



You'll play a key role in planning product assortments, forecasting demand, managing inventory investment, and ensuring the right product is in the right place at the right time.



Key Responsibilities



Merchandise Planning

- Develop and manage merchandise financial plans across sales, margin, stock and intake.

- Produce monthly forecasts and reforecasts, identifying risks and opportunities.

- Manage Open-to-Buy (OTB) to support business sales and inventory targets.

- Analyse performance at department, category and subcategory level.

- Recommend buying depth, assortment and product mix based on customer demand and commercial performance.



Inventory & In-Season Trading

- Monitor inventory productivity and optimise stock investment.

- Recommend actions to pull forward or defer intake based on trading.

- Drive size curve recommendations by brand, category and store.

- Plan and execute store distribution strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve sell-through and reduce excess inventory.

- Manage replenishment, allocations and store transfers where required.



Product Lifecycle Management

- Maintain visibility of inventory throughout the product lifecycle.

- Monitor product performance from launch through markdown.

- Develop and execute markdown and promotional pricing strategies.

- Manage full-price and markdown stock consolidations.

- Identify underperforming products and recommend corrective actions.

- Ensure purchase orders are received accurately and managed through to completion.



Forecasting & Reporting

- Produce weekly and monthly trading reports.

- Present insights and recommendations to key stakeholders.

- Monitor core product forecasts and update plans regularly.

- Analyse store capacity and support inventory planning by location.



Collaboration

- Partner closely with Buying, Retail Operations, Logistics and Warehouse teams.

- Build strong relationships across the business.

- Contribute to process improvements and planning initiatives.

- Support new store openings through assortment planning.







About You



You'll be analytical, commercially curious and comfortable making decisions using data.



You'll ideally have:



- 2+ years' experience in Merchandise Planning within retail.

- Strong commercial acumen and understanding of retail financial metrics.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Experience with merchandise planning systems (AP21, Oracle, SAP, JDA, Blue Yonder or similar is advantageous).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- A proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.





What You'll Bring

- Strong understanding of sales, margin, inventory and forecasting.

- Ability to interpret data and translate it into commercial actions.

- High attention to detail.

- Confidence presenting recommendations to stakeholders.

- A collaborative, team-first approach.

- Self-motivation and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.





What We Offer

- Fully remote role based in Sydney.

- Opportunity to work with an experienced Planning team.

- Exposure to a fast-paced retail environment.

- Ongoing development and career progression opportunities.

- Supportive, collaborative team culture.

mber went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Reach out directly to promising prospects and invite them to apply

Track applicants in a shared sheet and pass the shortlist to our team

Keep accounts healthy: capped daily follows, natural pacing, all manual — no bots, no automation



What We're Looking For



Native or fluent written Spanish — this one's non-negotiable

Reliable and consistent: a little every day, on schedule, for the full cycle

Comfortable using Instagram the normal way (not through automation tools)

Detail-oriented, and able to follow a written SOP exactly

Organized, with clean, accurate record-keeping

Bonus: solid English too, plus any interest in the Caribbean, community organizing, or nonprofit work



Hours & Commitment



Around 10 hours a week to start — part-time and ongoing. This is a long-term role: as we open more chapters, dependable people take on more of them, with real room to grow.



To Apply



Start your message with the word CARIBAEA, so we know you read all the way through.

In Spanish, write 2–3 sentences on why you'd be reliable in this role (this doubles as a quick check of your written Spanish).

Optional but helpful: link any social account or page you've managed.



Strong candidates will be invited to a short paid task to start, so we can see your work firsthand. Do it well, and you're on the team for ongoing work.

title: TikTok Shop Posting VA
description:

Successfully posted = video is uploaded correctly according to the SOP and recorded in the tracker.



25-30 videos posted per day per account (each account ~30 minutes per day).

WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY

Maintain consistent daily output, 6 days per week. A skilled VA can complete posting for one account in about 30 minutes. Most VAs cover 2–6 accounts per day.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English

- Reliable high-speed internet

———————————————————



HOW TO APPLY

———————————————————

— Next Wave Mktg Team

title: Full-Stack Developer, Website Support, and SEO
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced and trustworthy Full-Stack Developer to take over an existing business dashboard and ensure that all technical assets are fully owned, controlled, and documented under our company accounts.



The current system uses Vercel, Prisma, GitHub, and a small database. The selected developer will review the existing setup, transfer or reconnect all services to company-owned accounts, verify that the system is functioning correctly, and provide complete documentation and administrative access.



This role may also include ongoing website development, maintenance, performance improvements, and search engine optimization.



Project Objectives



The primary objective is to ensure that our company has full ownership and custody of:



* GitHub repositories and source code

* Vercel projects, deployments, domains, and environment variables

* Prisma database projects, credentials, and connection settings

* Database data, backups, schemas, and migration history

* Website hosting and domain-related configurations

* Third-party services, integrations, and API credentials

* Technical documentation and administrative access



All accounts and services must be registered using company-controlled
 addresses. Personal
 addresses, temporary Gmail accounts, personal phone numbers, or developer-owned accounts must not be used unless we provide written approval.



Responsibilities



The selected developer will:



1. Audit the existing dashboard, website, database, hosting, repositories, integrations, and account access.

2. Confirm the current ownership and administrator status of all GitHub, Vercel, Prisma, domain, database, analytics, and related accounts.

3. Transfer or recreate all services under company-owned accounts when necessary.

4. Migrate the GitHub repository into a company-owned GitHub organization or account while preserving:

   - Source code

   - Branches

   - Commit history

   - Issues

   - Deployment workflows

   - Collaborator permissions

   - Webhooks and integrations



5. Transfer or recreate the Vercel project while preserving:

    - Production and preview deployments

   - Custom domains

   - Environment variables

   - Build settings

   - Deployment settings

   - GitHub integration

   - Team permissions



6. Transfer or reconnect the Prisma database and verify:



   - Database availability

   - Schema integrity

   - Connection strings

   - Environment variables

   - Migration history

   - User permissions

   - Backup and recovery procedures



7. Test the complete application after migration to confirm that all dashboard features, website pages, forms, integrations, and database functions continue working correctly.

8. Remove unauthorized or unnecessary access after the transition is complete.

9. Provide secure administrative access to designated company representatives.

10. Create clear technical documentation covering:

- System architecture

- Hosting setup

- Repository structure

- Database configuration

- Deployment process

- Environment variables

- Backup procedures

- Account ownership

- User permissions

- Troubleshooting and recovery procedures

11. Assist with ongoing website updates, bug fixes, feature development, and technical maintenance.

12. Perform search engine optimization work, including:

- Technical SEO audit

- Page speed improvements

- Metadata optimization

- Heading and content structure

- Image optimization

- Sitemap and robots.txt review

- Google Search Console setup or review

- Analytics configuration

- Indexing issue resolution

- Mobile performance improvements

- Structured data recommendations



 Required Qualifications



* Proven experience with GitHub repository transfers and organization management

* Strong experience with Vercel project deployment and account migration

* Experience with Prisma ORM and Prisma-managed database environments

* Strong understanding of database backups, schemas, migrations, and access control

* Experience with modern web application development

* Ability to troubleshoot deployment and environment variable issues

* Knowledge of website security and administrator access management

* Experience with technical SEO and website performance optimization

* Ability to document systems clearly for nontechnical business owners

* Strong communication, professionalism, and transparency



Ownership and Security Requirements



The developer must agree that:

* All source code, databases, configurations, documentation, credentials, and project assets created or managed during the engagement belong exclusively to our company.

* All production accounts must be created under company-controlled
 addresses.

* The developer may not retain exclusive ownership or administrative control over any company system.

* The developer may not use personal accounts as the permanent owner of company assets.

* All credentials and access information must be provided to the company.

* The developer must disclose all third-party services and integrations used by the system.

* No company data or source code may be copied, retained, reused, or shared without written authorization.

* Access must be removed promptly when the engagement ends or when requested by the company.

* Any subcontractors must be disclosed and approved in advance.



Initial Deliverables

The initial engagement should include:

1. Complete technical audit

2. Written migration and ownership plan

3. Transfer of GitHub, Vercel, and Prisma assets

4. Verification of company administrator access

5. Database backup and recovery confirmation

6. Production testing after migration

7. Removal of unnecessary prior access

8. Complete system documentation

9. List of all recurring platform costs

10. Recommendations for website development and SEO

11. Estimated hours for ongoing support



Applicants should not provide a general estimate without first explaining the tasks included, expected hours, risks, and deliverables.



Preferred Engagement Structure



This may begin as a fixed-price migration and technical audit project. After successful completion, the developer may be considered for ongoing website development, dashboard improvements, maintenance, and SEO work.



Trust, transparency, complete company ownership, proper documentation, and reliable communication are essential requirements for this role.

title: Meta Ads Campaign Builder
description:
I’m looking for ONE full-time Meta Ads Campaign Builder to help us build advertising campaigns for touring comedians and live entertainment clients.



We already have the campaign structures, targeting frameworks, templates and internal tools in place.



Most campaigns will be built through our internal platform, ShowLauncher, with some work completed manually inside Meta Ads Manager.



Your job is to take approved campaign information and creative, build the campaign accurately, check your work, and hand it over for final QA.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands Meta Ads, follows processes carefully, and can handle a high volume of campaign builds without becoming sloppy.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll build:



- Purchase campaigns for ticket sales

- Lead campaigns using landing pages and Meta instant forms

- Engagement campaigns promoting
 events



You’ll work across ShowLauncher and Meta Ads Manager to build campaigns using our existing process, create and update custom audiences, set inclusions and exclusions, select the correct pixel and conversion event, and make sure every campaign is accurate before it reaches final QA.



You’ll also check locations, dates, budgets, links, copy and creative, fix obvious issues in AI-generated ad copy, update campaign statuses and due dates in ClickUp, and flag missing or conflicting information before it causes delays.



Some parts of the process are automated through ShowLauncher. Others need to be completed or checked manually inside Meta.



What You Need

- Previous experience using Meta Ads Manager

- Understanding of campaign structure, objectives, audiences and tracking

- Knowledge of custom audiences, inclusions and exclusions

- Understanding of the Meta Pixel and conversion events

- Strong attention to detail

- Good written English

- Basic marketing and copy judgment

- Ability to follow an established process

- Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

- Comfortable asking questions instead of guessing

- Reliable internet connection

- Full-time availability



Experience with live events, ticket sales, local advertising or entertainment clients is helpful, but not required.



We are open to training the right person if they understand the basics of Meta Ads, learn quickly and have strong attention to detail.



Who This Is For



This role will suit someone who naturally checks their work, notices small errors, follows instructions carefully and can work through a large queue without losing focus.



At first, you’ll be expected to stop and escalate anything unusual.



As you learn our process, you’ll take ownership of more standard issues yourself.



The comedians we work with often use strong language and adult humour, so you should be comfortable working with that.



This Is NOT

- A marketing strategy role

- A campaign management role

- A video editing role

- A client communication role

- A general virtual assistant role



You will not be responsible for ongoing campaign optimization, reporting or client communication.



This role is focused entirely on building campaigns for our clients.



You will not be responsible for advertising The Warm Up Guys, generating leads for our business, or managing our own marketing campaigns.



What Success Looks Like



- Campaigns are built by their internal due date, pass final QA without major corrections, and use the correct audience, pixel, conversion event, budget, creative and show information.



- Missing information is flagged early.

title: AI Content Creator (Images & Videos)
description:
Company Description:

We are a fast-growing ecommerce company that sells physical products through acquisition platforms

such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Amazon, Klaviyo, TikTok, Instagram, and more. Our creative team

produces a high volume of direct-response video ads, and AI-generated content sits at the center of that

production.





Role Description:

This is a remote contract role for an AI Video Content Creator. You will work alongside our existing AI

team to generate the AI image and video clips that power our ad creative — every day, at volume.



A typical day looks like this:

- Scripts are written and handed to the team each day. Each script needs a set of AI clips generated for

it, each described in a short brief (roughly 15–40 words) that tells you what the clip needs to show.



- You take that brief, build an image prompt to nail the base frame you want, then build the video

prompt to bring it to life — reprompting and refining until the clip is clean and ad-usable.



- Clips that go into ads get reviewed, and revision notes come back. You turn those revisions around

quickly and correctly.



- As older creative fatigues, you're continuously generating fresh clips to keep the content pipeline full.



The work spans many clip types — product, problem, solution, mechanism, and more creative concepts —

so range and prompting discernment matter as much as raw output.





Qualifications:

- Proven hands-on experience generating AI images and AI videos for ads or social content, using tools

like OpenArt (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Hailuo, etc.) and image models (Nano Banana, GPT Image,

Midjourney, Seedream, etc.).



- Strong prompting skill and discernment — you can get a specific result out of a model, not just

whatever it hands you, and you know how to fight a clip that won't come out right (bad motion, distorted

faces/hands, subject drifting, artifacts).



- Ability to maintain consistency across a sequence — keeping the same character, subject, or product

looking identical from clip to clip (reference images, start/end frames, etc.).



- Comfortable producing high volume — 15+ finished, ad-usable clips per day once ramped.



- Sharp eye for realism: outputs should look real and ad-ready, free of obvious AI artifacts.



- Excellent command of English (C1 level or higher) for clear team communication and following

written direction precisely.



- Availability to work on Eastern Standard Time (EST), with flexibility for tight deadlines and

occasional weekend work during launches.



- Key traits we value: proactiveness, creativity, adaptability, attention to detail, and the discipline to hit

volume without dropping quality.

title: Research Assistant for YouTube Channels (Trend-Spotting + Clip Sourcing)
description:
We run two growing YouTube commentary channels: one covering money and personal finance, one covering news and politics. We are hiring a part-time Research Assistant to help our Production Manager find the raw material that drives every video: short-form clips (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, news clip pages) worth reacting to.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Monitor TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and YouTube news clip channels daily for trending topics and standout clips in our two content lanes

- For assigned video topics, find candidate clips and submit them with the URL, length, creator handle, a one-line description, and a quality rating

- Suggest fresh video topic ideas DAILY with a short reason why each is worth covering now

- Study our channels and competitor channels regularly so you understand what we are building. Our aim is simple: make the best videos possible for the viewer

- Work directly with our Production Manager, who reviews everything you submit and gives feedback



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- You watch YouTube commentary/reaction content and understand how these videos are built: the hook, the story arc, why one clip carries a video and another falls flat

- You can tell the difference between a clip that is merely on-topic and a clip that makes people say "no way" out loud

- You are on TikTok/Reels/Shorts daily and know how to dig for gems before they go viral

- Reliable, fast communicator, comfortable with deadlines

- Experience helping a YouTube channel (research, sourcing, or editing) is a big plus, but a great eye matters more than a resume



A NOTE ON AI:

Using AI tools to help organize or draft your work is welcome IF the final quality is excellent. But do not use AI to find topics or trends. We have 15 years of experience in this space and can tell. Topic and trend suggestions must come from your own scrolling, watching, and judgment.



DETAILS:

- Part-time, remote, flexible hours with a daily check-in rhythm

- $
/month depending on experience, bi-weekly payment

- There is a PAID test task ($10 via PayPal) for shortlisted applicants, due within 24 hours of receiving it. Payment is for quality, good-faith submissions; low-effort submissions will not be paid

- Long-term role with growth path as the channels scale



HOW TO APPLY:

Reply with:

1. A few sentences about the YouTube commentary channels you actually watch and what makes their videos work

2. One link to a short-form clip (TikTok/Reel/Short) you think would be great material for a money-focused reaction video, and one sentence on why

3. Your monthly rate expectation

4. Start your reply with the word "STORYFLOW" so we know you read the full posting



Applications that skip any of these four items will not be considered.

title: Full-Stack Developer – Build a Tamagotchi-Style Virtual Pet Web App
description:
Full-Stack Developer – Build a Tamagotchi-Style Virtual Pet Web App

About Us




 is a fast-growing global pet platform dedicated to helping pet owners make better decisions through breed guides, educational content, YouTube videos and interactive experiences.



We're looking to create something unique—a modern browser-based virtual pet experience that encourages visitors to return every day while teaching responsible pet ownership.



This is an exciting opportunity to help build what we hope will become one of the flagship features of 
.



The Project



We want to develop an interactive virtual pet application inspired by classic Tamagotchi games, but designed for today's web.



Users will create their own virtual dog or cat, care for it over time, unlock achievements, customise its appearance, and learn real pet care along the way.



This is not intended to be a children's game. Instead, we want to create an engaging experience for pet lovers of all ages that combines entertainment with genuine education.



What You'll Build



The first version of the application will include:



Virtual Pet Creation



Users should be able to create their own pet by selecting:



Dog or Cat

Breed

Name

Appearance

Colour

Optional personality traits



Each pet should become unique to its owner.



Pet Dashboard



The pet should have dynamic statistics that change over time, including:



Hunger

Happiness

Health

Energy

Cleanliness

Exercise

Mental stimulation

Daily Care Activities



Users should interact with their pet through activities such as:



Feeding

Giving water

Playing

Walking

Grooming

Training

Sleeping



These actions should directly influence the pet's wellbeing.



Notifications



One of the most important features is keeping users engaged through smart notifications.



The application should notify users when their pet:



Is hungry

Needs water

Is bored

Needs exercise

Needs grooming

Is tired

Has low happiness

Has been left unattended



Notifications should support:



Browser push notifications

In-app notifications

Optional
 notifications

Future Progressive Web App (PWA) notifications



Notifications should feel as though they come from the pet itself.



Example:



"Charlie is getting hungry. Can we have dinner soon?"



The system should avoid excessive notifications and allow users to manage their notification preferences.



Rewards & Gamification



The application should encourage daily engagement through:



Daily rewards

Coins

Streaks

Achievements

Unlockable accessories

Breed Behaviour



Different breeds should behave differently.



For example:



Border Collies require more exercise and mental stimulation.

Bulldogs tire more easily.

Persian cats require regular grooming.



We want users to learn genuine breed characteristics through gameplay.



Educational Integration



This is one of the most exciting aspects of the project.



Whenever appropriate, the application should connect users with relevant 
 content.



Examples include:



Grooming guides

Feeding advice

Breed information

Training articles

Mental enrichment ideas

YouTube videos



The application should naturally encourage users to explore the rest of the website.



Technical Requirements



We're open to your recommendations regarding technology, but experience with the following would be highly regarded:



React

Next.js

Vue

Node.js

Firebase

Supabase

REST APIs

GraphQL

Browser Push Notifications

Progressive Web Apps (PWA)

Responsive Web Design

WordPress integration

Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who has experience building:



Browser-based games

Gamified web applications

Interactive dashboards

User account systems

Modern responsive web applications



Experience with casual gaming or educational applications would be a significant advantage.



Future Roadmap



This is only Phase One.



Future versions are expected to include:



Multiple pets

Puppy and kitten growth

Vet visits

Mini-games

Seasonal events

Community features

Rescue pets

Competitions

Leaderboards

AI-powered personalities

WooCommerce integration

Mobile app expansion



We're looking for someone who can build a solid foundation that can grow into a much larger platform.



What Success Looks Like



The finished application should be:



Fun and engaging

Easy to use

Beautifully designed

Fast and responsive

Mobile-friendly

Easy to expand

Well documented

Reliable and secure



Most importantly, it should encourage users to return every day while teaching responsible pet ownership.



To Apply



Please include:



Examples of similar web applications or browser games you have built.

Links to live projects or GitHub repositories where possible.

The technology stack you would recommend for this project and why.

Your estimated timeframe for developing Version 1.

Any suggestions or ideas you believe would improve the concept.



If you're passionate about building engaging web experiences and want to create something genuinely different for millions of pet lovers, we'd love to hear from you.

• Build and nurture strong client relationships through insightful, proactive communication.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

Your flexible working options 

We are committed to creating a flexible work environment that supports all our People to reach their potential. Where possible, we will make every effort to accommodate flexible working practices. Talk to us about how this role could be flexible for you.

Working at adva.group means being part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values innovation and collaboration. mbers are encouraged to grow and develop their skills and careers. 

At the adva.group, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the businesses and communities we serve, and we strive to create a culture of excellence in everything we do.



Capability



Experience and Qualifications 

To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate will have the following experience and qualifications:

title: Appointment Setter (Phone-Based, Part-Time)
description:
We're hiring a reliable, well-spoken Appointment Setter to manage our inbound lead flow by phone. This is a part-time, remote role for someone who is confident on the phone, follows a structured script/framework precisely, and is comfortable calling the same prospect more than once to keep appointments on the calendar.



Responsibilities



1. Call leads who have already booked an appointment with us

2. Qualify each lead over the phone using a specific qualification framework (provided during onboarding)

3. Confirm the appointment details with the lead during the initial call

4. Call each lead again the day before their scheduled appointment to reconfirm

5. Log call outcomes and lead qualification status accurately after every call

6. Flag any lead who no-shows, reschedules, or disqualifies so the calendar stays clean



Requirements



1. Fluent, native-level English — spoken and written

2. A clear, neutral North American or British English accent, easily understood by a US/UK audience with no listening effort required

3. Previous experience in appointment setting, telesales, customer service, or a similar phone-based role

4. Reliable internet connection and a quiet space to make calls

5. Comfortable following a set script/framework consistently while still sounding natural, not robotic

6. Strong attention to detail for logging call outcomes correctly





Hours & Pay

Approx. 3–4 hours per day (max)

Hourly pay, paid every 2 weeks

Remote position — flexible daily start time within agreed calling hours



How to Apply



Please

A brief summary of your relevant phone/appointment-setting experience

A short voice note (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself, so we can hear your speaking voice and accent clearly

Qualified tea
mbers are eligible for:

title: YouTube Script Writer (Mystery / Paranormal / Documentary)
description:
I'm looking for a talented long-form YouTube script writer for a large YouTube channel.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely enjoys researching and writing about mysteries, unexplained events, paranormal stories, strange disappearances, cryptids, haunted locations, historical mysteries, government mysteries, strange phenomena, and other intriguing real-world stories.



Think along the lines of:



MrBallen (mystery-focused episodes)

What Lurks Beneath

Dark historical mysteries

Ghost ships

Unexplained sightings

Lost expeditions

Creepy locations

Urban legends with historical research



Not interested in:



Graphic gore

Shock content

True crime murders

Cheap clickbait

Low-effort AI-generated writing



I want scripts that feel like they were written by someone who actually became fascinated with the story.



The ideal writer naturally goes down research rabbit holes and enjoys uncovering interesting details that make viewers think:



"Wait... that's actually really strange."

Approximately 4,000 - 6,000 words per script

Strong hook

Excellent pacing

Documentary storytelling style

Clean English

Entertaining while remaining grounded



Quality matters much more than speed.



I'd rather receive one excellent script than several average ones.



Pay



$50 USD per approved script. 



Potential for long-term work if we're a good fit.



To Apply



Please include:



The word BLUEBERRY in the subject heading of your message.

Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role.

Any experience writing YouTube scripts, documentaries, horror, mystery, or long-form content.

A sample of your work. Ideally a complete script around 4,000 - 6,000 words in the mystery, paranormal, documentary, or unexplained genre.

title: Full Time Tiktok Shop Video Editor
description:
Full Time TikTok Shop Video Editor

**MUST HAVE TIKTOK SHOP EDITING EXPERIENCE**

*Please read entire job description*



I am a top 1% TikTok Shop affiliate looking for a highly skilled, reliable full time short form video editor to join my team.



This is a 40 hour per week position, and I will have more than enough consistent work to keep you busy. I am looking for someone who wants a long term position and can consistently produce high quality work.



This is NOT a position for someone who only has experience with basic video editing. You must understand modern, fast paced short form content and how to edit videos that hold attention while still feeling natural and organic.



What I'm Looking For



• Strong experience editing TikTok, TikTok Shop, Reels, or similar short form content

• Ability to work 40 hours per week consistently

• Must use CapCut Pro for editing and our workflow

• Excellent understanding of fast paced short form editing

• Extremely good at removing ALL unnecessary pauses, dead space, mistakes, and slow 
nts

• Ability to make cuts feel natural and fluid without making the video feel overly edited

• Strong use of movement, including keyframes, zoom ins, zoom outs, and speed adjustments

• Understands that the first 1–2 seconds are extremely important and should visually grab attention

• Ability to add appropriate transitions and sound effects when needed

• Ability to properly color grade footage

• Ability to balance audio and maintain consistent volume throughout videos

• Strong attention to detail

• Able to follow instructions while also using your own creative judgment

• Reliable, responsive, and able to handle a consistent workload



The goal is to create high tempo, attention grabbing videos that still feel like organic TikTok content, not overly produced advertisements.



You will be working with a high volume of content, so speed and efficiency are important, but quality cannot suffer. I need someone who can consistently make good editing decisions without needing every individual cut explained to them.



Required Two Step Editing Trial



Before being hired, selected applicants will be required to complete editing trial from raw footage. 



When applying, please send examples of your best short form editing work, especially TikTok or TikTok Shop content.



I am looking to hire as soon as possible for a full time, long term position.

- Provide general administrative support (e.g., scheduling, data entry).

- Utilize platforms like WellSky or Axiscare (training provided) to streamline workflows.

- Collaborate with the owner to refine processes and maintain organization.



Qualifications:



- Excellent written/verbal communication (fluent English).

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Proficiency with CRM systems, email management, and cloud-based tools (e.g., Google Drive).

- Proactive mindset—anticipate needs before they arise.

- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in healthcare or home care staffing.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and team members.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with recruitment platforms and CRM tools

- A positive attitude, sense of humor, and a passion for helping others.

- Organization: You’re a master of multitasking and can keep everything running smoothly.

- Problem Solver: You can see the big picture when resolving complex issues and follow through until you reach full resolution.

- Reliability: You’re dependable, punctual, and always ready to step up when needed.



Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

- Make a Difference: You’ll play a key role in ensuring that clients receive the best care possible.

Ready to Be a Hero?

title: Short Term Rental Property Manager & Outreach
description:
ABOUT US



We are a rapidly growing short-term rental company building long-term partnerships with property owners through our corporate leasing model. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional guest experiences, running efficient operations, and leveraging technology and AI to scale our business.



We're looking for a proactive, resourceful, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant who enjoys solving problems, talking to people, and taking full ownership of their work. This is a long-term, full-time position with opportunities for increased responsibility and growth as the company continues to expand.



SCHEDULE



Full-time: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).



We're looking for someone who is available during these hours every weekday and is excited to grow with our company long-term.



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS — Priorities



This role has two sides, and the order matters.



1. Property Management Comes First



Guest communication, operations, scheduling, and platform support are always the top priority. These responsibilities are handled promptly every day.



2. Outreach Fills the Remaining Time



When property management tasks are under control, you'll shift your focus to outbound calling and business development. Outreach is an important part of the role, but it never comes at the expense of guests or operations.



We're looking for someone who can read the day, prioritize what matters most, and use quieter periods productively.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Primary — Property Management

Guest Communication

Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries before, during, and after their stay.

Resolve guest concerns while providing exceptional customer service.

Escalate issues appropriately when needed.

Operations & Scheduling

Coordinate cleaners, maintenance vendors, and tea
mbers.

Schedule appointments and keep operational tasks on track.

Monitor workflows and identify potential issues before they become problems.

Airbnb & Platform Support

Communicate with Airbnb and other booking platforms regarding reservations, disputes, reimbursement claims, guest complaints, and policy questions.

Professionally advocate for the company while remaining calm during challenging conversations.

Technology & Systems

Use AI tools to improve speed and efficiency.

Learn new software quickly.

Keep accurate records within our property management system.

Secondary — Business Development & Outreach



(Completed when property management responsibilities are already handled.)



Make outbound calls to property owners, real estate agents, and property managers.

Introduce our corporate leasing model and qualify potential properties.

Build rapport with prospects and confidently answer questions about our business.

Accurately document conversations and follow up with leads as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent suitable for U.S. phone calls.

Outstanding customer service and communication skills.

Highly organized with excellent judgment and the ability to prioritize urgent tasks.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software.

Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to improve productivity.

Comfortable making outbound calls and handling objections and difficult conversations.

A proven history of productive outbound calling. In previous full-time outreach roles, you consistently completed approximately 100–200 calls per day. (This is not a daily quota for this position—it simply demonstrates you're comfortable working efficiently when outreach is needed.)

Reliable high-speed internet.

A quality headset.

A quiet, professional workspace.

Preferred

Experience in short-term rentals or hospitality.

Experience using Airbnb.

Experience with Hostaway (strongly preferred).

Experience using CRM and task-management software.

Background in sales, customer support, cold calling, or virtual assistance.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



During your first 90 days, you'll be expected to:



Maintain fast guest response times and excellent guest satisfaction.

Handle daily operations with minimal supervision.

Coordinate cleaners and maintenance proactively.

Confidently communicate with Airbnb support, vendors, and guests.

Use downtime productively for outbound outreach.

Learn our systems quickly and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency using AI.



Our goal isn't to micromanage you. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems before they become problems, and becomes an indispensable member of our team.



WHO THRIVES HERE



The person who succeeds in this role is a self-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do. You naturally prioritize what's most important, stay calm while juggling multiple responsibilities, communicate confidently, and follow through until the job is done.



You're dependable, detail-oriented, resourceful, and genuinely enjoy learning new technology and finding better ways to work.



HOW TO APPLY



To show us you read the full posting, please begin your application with the codeword "GROWTH" and include:



A short note describing your property management, guest support, and outbound calling experience.

Any experience you have with short-term rentals, Airbnb, or Hostaway.

A 1–2 minute video introduction telling us:

A little about yourself.

A challenging customer or guest situation you've handled.

Why you're interested in this role.



Applications that do not include the codeword or video introduction will not be considered.



We read every complete application and look forward to meeting the right person to join our growing team.

title: Marketing & Operations Assistant
description:
We're not looking for just another virtual assistant looking for a job. This position is a stepping stone into a growing digital marketing agency where you'll play a key role in keeping our projects organized, supporting our team, and helping launch client Meta advertising campaigns.



If you take pride in staying organized, supporting a growing team, and making sure projects are completed accurately and on time, this role could be a great fit for you.



We start part time at 15 hours per week so we can get comfortable working together, with the goal of transitioning you into a long term, full time position as we grow. We want someone who's committed, reliable, and excited to become a dedicated member of our team.



Our goal isn't to hire someone for a few months. We're looking for someone who wants to grow alongside the agency. As we continue to take on more clients, you'll have the opportunity to learn new skills, take on more responsibility, and play an important role in helping build TEN98.



As you read this description, feel free to ask any questions you have. Clear communication and curiosity are valued here at TEN98.



This posting is for an audition. We will choose several candidates for a paid test project. After reviewing everyone's work, we'll d
 who we'd like to bring onto the team long term.



Experience using ClickUp is strongly preferred. Experience with Meta Ads is a bonus, but not required. Most of what you'll be doing can be taught. We're much more interested in finding someone who's organized, dependable, eager to learn, and takes pride in keeping projects running smoothly.



POSITION OVERVIEW



Your role is to help keep our agency running efficiently.



Tyler handles sales, strategy, copywriting, creative direction, and client communication. Your focus will be keeping projects organized, managing ClickUp, supporting our Meta advertising campaigns using our SOPs, and making sure every client project moves from start to finish without anything falling through the cracks.



Your responsibilities include:



• Project Management (Primary Responsibility)



Creating and organizing ClickUp projects, assigning tasks, updating project statuses, tracking deadlines, following up on outstanding items, and ensuring every client project stays organized and on schedule.



• Meta Ads Support



Building campaign structures using our SOPs, uploading approved creatives and ad copy, creating Instant Forms, quality checking campaigns before launch, preparing reports, and assisting with campaign updates. (Meta Ads experience is a bonus, but not required. We'll teach you if you're interested!)



• Agency Operations



Collecting client assets, organizing Google Drive folders, updating internal documentation, improving SOPs, and helping keep our internal systems clean and organized.



• Administrative Support



Scheduling meetings, sending follow up
s, organizing documents, and helping wherever needed to keep the agency operating efficiently.



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT LOOK LIKE



No two weeks are exactly the same, but your week might include things like:



• Organizing ClickUp and making sure every client project stays on track.



• Following up on missing assets or outstanding tasks.



• Building and quality checking Meta advertising campaigns using our SOPs.



• Uploading approved creatives and creating Instant Forms.



• Preparing monthly client reports.



• Organizing Google Drive folders and updating internal documentation.



• Scheduling meetings and helping with day to day agency tasks.



• Looking for ways to improve our systems and make the agency run even more efficiently.



QUALITIES NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL



At TEN98, we care more about who you are than what you know right now. We're looking for the following qualities.



• Integrity



Be honest, responsible, and upfront. Communicate clearly if something is unclear or if you've made a mistake. We'll never be upset with honest mistakes, and you can never ask too many questions. The only way we grow is by working together.



• Commitment



We're looking for someone who wants a long term role, not a short freelance project or someone hoping to juggle multiple full time jobs. We want someone who takes pride in their work and is excited to grow with us.



• Desire to Learn



We're growing quickly and want someone who's excited to learn new skills, tools, and processes. We're looking for someone who's curious, coachable, and motivated to improve.



• Organization & Attention to Detail



This is the most important quality for this role. You'll be responsible for keeping projects organized, following checklists, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks. If you naturally create order and catch small mistakes before they become bigger problems, you're who we need!



REQUIREMENTS



• Experience using ClickUp or another project management platform (ClickUp preferred)



• Strong organizational skills



• Excellent attention to detail



• Reliable and responsive communication



• Ability to follow SOPs and checklists



• Comfortable learning new software and systems



• Stable internet connection



• Willingness to grow into a full time role



• Ability to work EST business hours



Bonus (Not Required)



• Experience with Meta Ads Manager



• Experience working in a marketing agency



• Experience with GoHighLevel



• Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude



WHAT WE OFFER



• Part time hours to start (approximately 15 hours per week)



• Opportunity to grow into a full time position



• Performance bonuses and raises



• Clear training and communication



• A positive and supportive online work environment



• Opportunity to learn valuable digital marketing skills



• Room to grow into a larger role as the agency expands



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following:



• A short introduction about yourself.



• Your experience using ClickUp and how you've used it to manage projects.



• Any experience you have with project management, administrative work, digital marketing, or Meta Ads.



• Your typical weekly availability and whether you're currently working for another company.



• A short message about what interests you about this position.



Bonus: If you'd like to stand out, include a 2 to 3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a great fit for the role.



If you have any questions, please ask. You can never ask too many questions!



To confirm you've read the entire job posting, please begin your application with the phrase: "Newport Waters."



I look forward to meeting you!



Tyler

TEN98 Marketing

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Purchasing Manager
description:
We operate a high-volume Amazon resale business and are looking for a highly analytical, trustworthy, and experienced Purchasing Manager to oversee our final buying decisions.



Currently, we have a team of Virtual Assistants who source leads through Storefront Stalking and submit them for review. Your role is to serve as the final filter before company funds are spent. You will review submitted leads, verify their profitability and compliance with our purchasing criteria, and make the final decision on whether inventory should be purchased.



We currently spend $8,000–$10,000 per day on inventory. This means you will be responsible for helping manage significant capital. We are looking for someone who treats company money as if it were their own, makes decisions based strictly on data and ROI, and is interested in growing into our full-time Lead Purchaser.



?



How the Position Works



Phase 1: Paid Trial & Calibration (1–2 Weeks)



Your first phase is a paid trial where we’ll start with a limited number of purchasing decisions while we calibrate your judgment to our business.



During this phase, you will:



* Review leads submitted by our sourcing team.

* Verify all key metrics (Keepa history, SellerAmp data, IP risk, supplier legitimacy, etc.).

* Make mock or small-scale purchasing decisions.

* Receive detailed feedback to align your decision-making with our purchasing standards.



Phase 2: Scaling Up



As you demonstrate consistency and sound judgment, your purchasing authority will gradually increase. The goal is for you to eventually manage our full daily purchasing budget independently.



Phase 3: Full-Time Purchaser



Once fully calibrated, you will become the final gatekeeper for all inventory purchases. Your performance will be measured by the quality of your purchasing decisions, the ROI of approved products, and your ability to avoid bad buys.



?



Responsibilities



* Review daily product leads submitted through Google Sheets.

* Verify all key data points, including:

    * Sales Rank

    * ROI

    * Profit

    * Buy Box stability

    * IP risk

    * Supplier legitimacy

* Make final Go/No-Go purchasing decisions.

* Execute purchases using company payment methods (once trust has been established).

* Provide feedback to sourcing VAs to improve lead quality.

* Track daily purchasing activity and maintain accurate purchasing logs.



?



Requirements



Required



* Deep expertise in Amazon Online Arbitrage and product analysis.

* Advanced proficiency with Keepa, including interpreting charts, identifying price tanking risks, and understanding listing history.

* Advanced proficiency with SellerAmp SAS.

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

* Excellent spoken and written English.



Preferred



* Previous experience serving as a final reviewer or purchaser for an Amazon Online Arbitrage business.



?



Who This Role Is For



You will thrive in this role if you are:



* Analytical — You trust data over intuition.

* Decisive — You confidently make purchasing decisions when the data supports them.

* Cautious — You know how to recognize risky inventory before money is spent.

* Coachable — You are willing to learn and consistently apply our purchasing criteria.



This is not a role for someone who rushes through reviews or guesses. Every bad purchase costs the business money. Every good purchase helps it grow.



?



The Hiring Process & Front-End Filtering



To ensure we hire the right person for this role, our application process is intentionally selective. It is designed to evaluate attention to detail, analytical ability, communication skills, and real Amazon OA knowledge.



We also require a Loom video to help verify that responses are genuine and not AI-generated.



?



Before You Apply



Please read this entire posting carefully.



To be considered, follow these instructions exactly:



1. Put “Gatekeeper” as the first word in the subject line.

2. Include your
 address.

3. Answer the text questions below using numbered responses.

4. Record a 3–5 minute Loom video answering the video questions below and include the Loom link in your application.

5. End your application with the phrase “Data drives decisions.”

6. Do not attach a résumé.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.



?



Application Questions (Text Responses)



1. Experience



Describe your experience making final purchasing decisions or analyzing Amazon OA leads using Keepa and SellerAmp.



Have you served as the final purchaser before? If so, describe your responsibilities.



2. Supplier Legitimacy



List five (5) supplier characteristics or red flags that would immediately cause you to reject a supplier as unreliable or potentially fraudulent.



3. Attention to Detail



What is the 5th word in the 3rd paragraph under the “About the Role” section of this job post?



4. Availability



Are you available to begin a paid trial immediately upon acceptance?



Answer Yes or No.



?



Application Questions (Loom Video)



Please answer the following questions verbally.



Do not read from a script.



1. Keepa Walkthrough



Open any Keepa chart and explain why the product is or is not a good purchase based on the data.



2. SellerAmp Test



Walk through exactly how you evaluate a lead inside SellerAmp SAS.



What information do you check first?



What findings would immediately cause you to reject the lead?



3. Judgment Scenario



A lead has:



* 20% ROI

* $12 profit

* 180 monthly sales

* FBA Buy Box

* Walmart as the supplier

* Stable Keepa pricing



However, Walmart entered the Amazon listing twice during the past month and became the lowest-priced seller both times.



Would you purchase this lead? Why or why not?



?



Internal Hiring Process (For Employer)



1. Post the Job



Publish this posting on OnlineJobs.ph, Upwork, or your preferred hiring platform.



2. Initial Filter



Immediately reject applications that:



* Do not begin the subject line with “Gatekeeper.”

* Do not include a Loom video.

* Do not end with “Data drives decisions.”



3. Review Text Responses



Verify that the applicant:

4. Review the Loom Video



Evaluate:

* Confidence

* Communication ability

* Keepa knowledge

* SellerAmp proficiency

* Purchasing judgment



For the Walmart scenario, the ideal response is to reject the lead or explain why competing directly with Walmart presents an unacceptable pricing risk.



5. Interview

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Role 



We are looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our creative team and support the design needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. This role is ideal for someone who understands the fundamentals of strong visual design, brand consistency, layout, typography, color theory, and digital-first creative production. 



The right candidate should be comfortable creating professional design assets for websites, social media, paid advertising, branding,
 campaigns, and occasional print materials. We value designers who can think creatively, follow brand guidelines, adapt to different client industries, and produce high-quality work without relying heavily on AI-generated design. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow, but this role requires a designer with real design judgment, strong fundamentals, and hands-on experience using professional creative software. 



Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid ads,
 campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta ads, Google display ads, organic social media content, website banners, blog images, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and brand collateral. 



Support brand identity development, including logos, color palettes, typography selections, brand guidelines, and visual systems. 



Edit, resize, and adapt creative assets for multiple platforms and formats. 



Work with marketing, web development, and content teams to create visuals that align with campaign goals and client brand standards. 



Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print use. 



Maintain organized design files and follow internal naming, storage, and version-control practices. 



Review creative briefs and translate business goals into visually effective design concepts. 



Ensure all creative work is consistent, polished, and aligned with each client’s brand voice and audience. 



Make revisions based on feedback while maintaining strong design quality and attention to detail. 



Stay current with design trends, digital advertising formats, social media creative standards, and modern design tools. 



Required Qualifications 



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Visual Designer, Brand Designer, or similar creative role. 



Strong portfolio showing professional design work across digital marketing, branding, websites, social media, and advertising. 



Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including layout, hierarchy, typography, color, composition, spacing, and brand consistency. 



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially: 



Adobe Photoshop 



Adobe Illustrator 



Adobe InDesign 



Adobe XD or Adobe Express is a plus 



Ability to create and edit original design assets, not just modify templates. 



Experience designing for digital marketing campaigns, including Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram graphics, Google display ads, and website imagery. 



Ability to follow brand guidelines and adapt design style across multiple client brands. 



Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, client-ready work. 



Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. 



Good communication skills and ability to accept feedback professionally. 



Preferred Qualifications 



Experience working in a digital marketing agency, web agency, or creative agency. 



Canva experience for creating editable client-facing templates. 



Experience with Figma, Sketch, or other modern UI/design collaboration tools. 



Basic understanding of website design principles, responsive layouts, and UX/UI best practices. 



Experience creating brand identity packages, social media ad campaigns, and landing page graphics. 



Experience preparing files for print production. 



Basic understanding of motion graphics, video editing, or animation is a plus. 



Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar platforms is a plus. 



Experience designing for different industries and client types. 



AI Tool Expectations 



We are open to the use of AI tools as part of a creative workflow, but this position is not for someone who depends on AI to do the core design work. The ideal candidate understands how to create strong designs from scratch, make thoughtful creative decisions, and use professional design tools with confidence. 



AI may be used for brainstorming, concept exploration, or workflow support, but final creative work must reflect strong human design judgment, originality, brand awareness, and professional execution. 



What We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can: 



Think creatively while still designing with business goals in mind. 



Understand the difference between attractive design and effective design. 



Create work that looks professional, intentional, and brand-aligned. 



Balance creativity with speed and production needs. 



Take direction while also contributing ideas. 



Work across multiple brands without making every design look the same. 



Understand how design impacts marketing performance, user experience, and brand perception. 



Portfolio Requirement 



Applicants must submit a portfolio with examples of relevant design work. We are especially interested in seeing: 



Brand identity or logo work 



Social media graphics 



Paid ad creative 



Website imagery or landing page design 



Print collateral 



Before-and-after design improvements 



Any examples showing original layout, typography, and composition skills 



Job Type 



Full-time, part-time, or contract, depending on candidate fit and availability. 



Schedule 

Flexible, but availability during standard business hours for meetings, feedback, and collaboration is preferred. 



How to Apply 



Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a short note explaining your design experience, the tools you use most often, and the type of creative work you enjoy most.
