title: Short Term Rental Property Assistant & Outreach
description:
ABOUT US



We are a rapidly growing short-term rental company building long-term partnerships with property owners through our corporate leasing model. We pride ourselves on exceptional guest experiences, efficient operations, and using technology and AI to scale.



We're looking for a proactive, resourceful, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant who enjoys solving problems, talking to people, and taking full ownership of their work. This is a long-term role, and it's eligible to grow from part-time to full-time for the right person who does the job well.





SCHEDULE



Monday–Friday, 1:00–5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST). Part-time to start, with a clear path to full-time based on performance.





HOW THIS ROLE WORKS — Priorities



This role has two sides, and the order matters:

1. Property management comes first. Guest communication, operations, scheduling, and platform support are always the top priority. These get handled promptly, every day.



2. Outreach fills the remaining time. When property management tasks are minimal or already handled, you'll shift to outbound calling and business development. It's the secondary responsibility — important, but never at the expense of guests and operations.



We're looking for someone who can read the day, take care of what's urgent first, and use the quieter stretches to drive outreach.





RESPONSIBILITIES



Primary — Property Management

1. Guest Communication: Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries before, during, and after their stay.

Resolve guest concerns while maintaining excellent service, escalating to the team when needed.



2. Operations & Scheduling: Coordinate cleaners, maintenance vendors, and tea
mbers when operational issues arise.

Schedule appointments and keep tasks on track.

Watch operational workflows and flag potential issues before they become problems.



3. Airbnb & Platform Support: Communicate with Airbnb and other platforms on reservations, disputes, reimbursement claims, guest complaints, and policy questions.

Advocate professionally for the company to reach the best possible outcomes, staying calm through difficult conversations.



4. Technology & Systems: Use AI tools to work faster and smarter.

Learn new software quickly and keep records accurate in our property management system.





Secondary — Business Development & Outreach

(When property management responsibilities are light or already handled.)



1. Make outbound calls to property owners, real estate agents, and property managers.



2. Introduce our corporate leasing model and qualify properties for corporate leasing and/or short-term rental use.



3. Build rapport with prospects and confidently answer common questions about our business.



4. Accurately document each conversation and follow up with leads as needed.





QUALIFICATIONS



Required



- Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear, neutral accent for US phone calls.

- Strong customer service and communication skills.

- Highly organized and dependable, with the judgment to prioritize urgent property management tasks before outreach.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

- Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to boost efficiency.

title: Senior Operations Manager and Right Hand to Owner: Short & Long Term Rentals
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

We are a growing property management firm managing luxury STRs in Tennessee and an LTR portfolio in Minnesota. We are not looking for a task-doer. We are looking for the owner's right hand: a proactive, system-minded leader who can run our evenings and weekends like they own them, help lead new projects and initiatives with the owner, and develop and improve the internal systems we run on.



WHY THIS ROLE:

We're looking for a tea
mber who will take ownership, think creatively, and contribute to refining our systems as we grow. We're excited to build a lasting relationship with someone in this role, ensuring you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions. This isn't a role for a task-doer or someone who is most comfortable in a role that primarily involves following a checklist. This is a role for a creative problem-solver with a high EQ and excellent communication skills and follow-through.



Real Authority: You'll have real authority to resolve issues, including a spending limit. When something breaks at 9PM, you are the decision-maker, not a message-forwarder. The owner should hear about most problems after they've been solved. This is a high-trust position, and that trust will be earned: your authority grows as you demonstrate judgment.



A Seat That Grows: This role is built to grow into an overall management position across the business, on evidence, not promises. You'll work directly with the owner and act as the connective layer for our small team.



Growth-Minded & Solutions-Focused: We don't dwell on problems; we find solutions. We want people who are hungry to learn, grow, and improve our systems every day.



Positive Energy: Property management and guest hospitality involve surprise challenges. Pipes burst, guests lock themselves out. We approach our work with a positive attitude and a "can-do" spirit.



A Relationship, Not a Transaction: We want a years-long partnership. Impact over activity: you won't be micromanaged; you'll be given clear goals, real trust, and the freedom to execute.



This role is approximately 40 hours per week. Your compensation will reflect your experience, initiative, growth, and contribution to the business's success.



Schedule (this is the heart of the role, please read carefully):

Friday and Saturday 3:00PM to 12:00 midnight, and Sunday through Tuesday 3:00PM to 11:00PM, US Eastern time. Wednesday and Thursday off.

These hours are when our guests check in, our team is offline, and our owner needs full coverage. Reliable presence during this exact window is a hard requirement.



YOUR CORE MISSION



Evenings & Weekend Command (about half your time):

During your shift, you are the front line and the d
 for the whole business. Guest messages and check-in issues at our Tennessee cabins. Urgent tenant and contractor issues in Minnesota. The surprise problems that don't respect business hours. Your job is to resolve them with judgment and calm, using your authority and our established playbooks, so the owner's evening stays quiet. Success is measured by how rarely problems need to reach him, and how completely they're handled when he reads about them the next morning.



Operations & Loop-Closing (about a third):

The "Loop-Closer": when a task comes in, you manage the communication, the schedule, and the reporting in 
 and in daily report-outs to the team. You make sure work moves from "reported" to "fully completed," and that everyone involved has what they need. You coordinate repairs and vendors, maintain inventory across properties, oversee move-in/move-out procedures, document interactions, and identify potential issues before they become problems. You work alongside our STR specialist and our LTR property manager as the connective layer between them and the owner.



Special Projects & Marketing (the remainder):

You take on the owner's next-most-important thing: marketing pushes 
 campaigns, social, listing platforms), process building, research, and whatever the business needs next. This is where the role grows.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:

3+ years working in a US-based business with operations responsibility.



High C2 fluency in English: Confident in multi-person meetings, initiating phone calls, and in non-scripted situations in English.

Proven judgment: You have made real decisions with real stakes, without waiting for permission, and you can tell us about them specifically.

The "Loop-Closer" DNA: You live by the 24-hour no-update rule. If a project is open, you provide an update before we have to ask.

Highly detail-oriented and organized: Able to track tasks across multiple properties, prioritize by urgency and importance, and follow up on outstanding issues.

A positive growth mindset, and proactive communication: you don't wait to be asked for updates, and you're receptive to feedback.

Availability for the exact schedule above, reliably, long-term.



The Tech Stack: We use OwnerRez, 
, and Google Workspace. We value your operations judgment over your specific software experience; if you've run comparable tools, we can train you on our stack.



MUST HAVE reliable internet connection with backup.

Proficiency with Google Drive, WhatsApp, and ability to quickly learn 
.



HOW TO APPLY:



To verify your attention to detail, please follow these steps exactly:



Subject Line: Include the name of the original bass player for the Grateful Dead.



Cover Letter (Paragraph 3): Include the phrase "closing the loop."



In your response, confirm you are available for the exact days and times described above.



1) Describe a specific time you solved an urgent problem without waiting for direction. How did it start, what steps did you take, what did it cost, and how was it resolved?



2) Describe a time you spent your employer's money (or made a binding decision) on your own authority to fix a problem. What was the situation, what did you d
, and how did your boss react?



3) At any 
nt you'll have multiple open items running: say a repair waiting on a contractor, an unhappy guest, and a supply order all live at once. Two things: (1) What system do you personally use to track these so nothing slips and everyone gets an update before they have to ask? (2) When you can't get to everything, how do you d
 what comes first? Give a real example showing both.



Please include a resume or summary of your background. If you have professional recommendations from previous US-based employers, we strongly encourage you to include them.



4) Tell us how your previous experience sets you up to excel in this role. We're especially interested in where you've led or developed people, built or improved systems, and operated with real autonomy.



A note on AI: We use it too, so use whatever tools help you. That said, we receive many applications with virtually identical answers to our application questions, which are obviously written by AI.

We'd much prefer to read about your real experience, in detail, in your own words. However you use AI, we ask one thing in return: be straight about what you've actually done and how you actually communicate. And tell us two things: how you used AI to put this application together, and how you'd use it in the day-to-day of this role.

description:
(Growth potential into QuickBooks Online / reconciliation work for the right candidate)



Company: RxBooks Inc. — a US-based bookkeeping firm specializing in independent pharmacies.

About the role



We're looking for a detail-oriented records organizer to support a historical bookkeeping backfill project for one of our pharmacy clients. This is 100% file-organization and data-entry work — you will never touch our live accounting systems, and you will never contact the client directly. All questions go through me.



What you'll do:



Organize bank statement exports into monthly files following a specific naming convention

Build monthly transaction count summaries (deposits, withdrawals, check/Zelle/ATM counts)

Build a check register from scanned check images — transcribing check number, date, amount, payee, and memo exactly as written

Build a Zelle transaction register, flagging repeat payees that may become automation rules

Follow a strict "flag it, don't guess it" standard: if something is illegible, blank, or missing, you mark it clearly rather than guessing at an answer



What this is not:

This is not data entry into QuickBooks or any live system

This is not client-facing — no calls,
s, or messages to the client, ever

This is not a role where speed is rewarded over accuracy — we would always rather you flag something and ask than guess and be wrong



Growth potential — please read if this applies to you



This role starts scoped to Google Drive files only. However, we are also looking to grow this into an ongoing position that includes QuickBooks Online reconciliation and transaction review as the engagement matures.



If you have QuickBooks Online experience, a bookkeeping background, or reconciliation experience, please say so clearly in your application — candidates with this background will be considered for the expanded, ongoing role first.



Requirements

Strong written English — you'll be documenting your work clearly and batching questions professionally

High attention to detail, and comfort with flagging uncertainty rather than guessing

Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel

Bookkeeping, data-entry, or QuickBooks Online experience is a plus (see above)

Reliable internet connection and your own computer

Available to complete a short, paid test task as part of the hiring process



Terms



We keep initial commitment low on both sides, and pay scales with actual work delivered rather than a flat monthly salary:



Step 1 — Short paid trial: a small, real piece of the work (roughly 2–3 hours, over about one week), paid a flat $25. This lets us both confirm fit before anything bigger.

Step 2 — Ongoing work, paid per deliverable: once the trial goes well, you're paid $25 per account-month package completed — one month of one bank account, fully processed (count summary + check register + Zelle register). This is typically a few hours of focused work. Pay is not capped to a monthly amount — complete more packages, earn more; this rate may be revisited upward once your first few packages confirm speed and quality.

If this grows into the QuickBooks Online track described above, that ongoing work is priced separately and at a higher rate, reflecting the added skill and responsibility.



Additional terms:



NDA and IP assignment required before receiving access to any files (including the short trial)

W-8BEN required (standard US tax form for foreign independent contractors)



To apply



Please message with:



A short intro and your relevant experience (data entry, bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, or similar)

Whether you have QuickBooks Online experience specifically

Your available hours per week and timezone

Confirmation you're comfortable signing an NDA and IP assignment before receiving any files

title: AI Product Image Generator (Fashion) — Growth Path to Department Head
description:
AI Product Image Generator (Fashion) — Growth Path to Department Head



Part-time to start, Full-time soon

Pay: $0.50 per product (photo set), increasing fast — see growth path below to monthly salary position

Working Hours: Flexible, full time, deadline-based





IMPORTANT — READ FIRST:



This role is 100% attention to detail. If you skim job posts and apply without reading, this is not the job for you — you will not last a week. To prove you read this fully, start your application with the word "PRECISE" in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.





About the Role:



We run fashion dropshipping stores and are scaling fast. Our product lister handles everything about a new product EXCEPT the images — that's you. You take the original product photo and use it to generate new, professional-looking images of the product on our own models, using an online generation tool we will show you once onboarded . We provide the account, no cost to you.



You will follow a detailed step-by-step SOP that covers:



- How to select the right reference model for each product type (dresses, tops, bottoms, outerwear, swimwear)

- How to prompt correctly so the AI keeps the right silhouette, length, and fit

- How to generate a full set of poses per product (front, side, back, close-up, flat lay, editorial)

- How to handle multiple color/style variants efficiently

- How to export and organize final images for Shopify



The SOP is thorough, but AI tools are imperfect — the product it generates won't always match the original exactly (wrong length, wrong color, wrong detail). Your job is to catch that, fix it, and regenerate until it's accurate. This is where the real skill is: knowing when something is "off" and not letting it slip through.



Pay Potential (read this before dismissing $0.50/product):



This is not as low as it sounds. At a strong, precise pace, most people can complete 12-15 product image sets per hour — that works out to $6-7.50/hour, which is on par with or above what most product listing VA jobs pay ($2-5/hour). Our daily target is 30 products (roughly 2-3 focused hours of work), and once you're experienced, some people push to 50/day if they want the extra pay. We're not asking for 50/day as a requirement — we'd rather have 30 done with zero mistakes than 50 with sloppy ones.



What We Need From You:



- Sharp eye for detail — able to spot when a generated image doesn't match the original product (fit, color, fabric, length)

- Patience to regenerate/revise until it's right, without cutting corners

- Ability to follow a structured SOP exactly, and flag when something in the SOP doesn't work for a specific product

- Reliable daily output — hitting the realistic target of discussed amount of fully-precise product image sets per day once trained

- No prior design/Photoshop experience needed — this is a trainable skill, not a portfolio job. What matters is precision and consistency, not creativity.



Training:



Expect 1-2 days to get comfortable with the tool and workflow. It's straightforward once you've done it a handful of times, but it IS time-consuming — this is a volume + precision job, not a fast one.



Growth Path (this matters — read this part):



This is not a flat piece-rate job forever. As we scale, we'll be uploading 50-100 products/day across stores, which is far more than one person can handle at the precision level we require. We need someone from this role to grow into **Head of Image Generation**, meaning:



- Onboarding and training new image generators

- Reviewing their output for quality before it goes live

- Owning the department's consistency and speed as we scale



Whoever proves they can do this role at a high standard will move into that position with a fixed monthly salary on top of increased per-product rates for the team's output — not just $0.50/unit forever. We're hiring the first person into this role specifically because we want to promote from within, not because we want a rotating door of freelancers.



How to Apply:



Include the word "PRECISE" in your subject line. In your application, tell us:

1. Have you used any AI image tools before? If yes, which ones.

2. Describe a time in a past job where attention to detail mattered and you caught a mistake others missed.

3. Are you comfortable with a role that starts as piece-rate but has a clear path to a fixed salary + leadership position?



We will do an interview selection process, send the full SOP and a short paid trial batch to shortlisted applicants before final hire.



MS INDUSTRIES LLC

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Team Growth and Standards: Help grow our junior editors and improve how we work. You will share what you know, give clear feedback on their edits, and streamline our editing practices, templates, and workflows so the whole team moves faster and more consistently.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one.



Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include it move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

mbers who consistently identify profitable opportunities that generate lasting value for the business.

title: New York Registered Nurse (RN) – Remote | RPM / CCM / RTM Patient Outreach

Review and discuss vital sign data, device readings, and symptom trends with patients

?

. This is a long-term seat on a growing team. We are not looking for gig work or a freelancer juggling five clients.

You'll cut short-form direct response video ads for Meta and Instagram from raw footage, a written script, and editor notes. Expect roughly 4 to 8 ads/content per week once you're up to speed, with revision rounds handled through 
.



**What you must already know how to do



This is not an entry-level role. You should be able to do all of the following without being taught:



- Color grade raw and log footage properly. We shoot log, and you need to know what to do with it.

- Speed ramping, in the style of high-end real estate and property videos

- Animated text and kinetic typography that actually looks designed, not templated

- Cut for retention. You need to understand hooks, pacing, and why a video flows the way it does. We care more about this than anything else on the list.



**Nice to have, not required



-After Effects

-3D animation or 3D text



**Software



You must be fluent in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. We are not hiring CapCut editors.



***Requirements



- Proven experience editing video ads specifically. Wedding, YouTube long-form, and real estate reels alone won't cut it here.

- A computer that can handle 4K log and raw footage without crawling

- Stable, fast internet for downloading large footage files

- Exclusive to us. During the part-time phase you may not work with any competing agency or home services client. Once you move to full-time, this becomes fully exclusive.



**Hours and pay



Starting at 20 hours per week at $10 to $15 per hour depending on experience, moving to full-time for the right person. 



**Our hiring process



1. Portfolio review. If your profile has no portfolio, you will not be considered. No exceptions.



2. Interview with a live editing test. A video call where we go deep on your process. title: AI Systems Architect & Automation Engineer
description:
About AirUs



AirUs is a rapidly growing UK short-term rental and property management company currently managing approximately 25 properties, with plans to grow beyond 150.



We are not looking to build a simple chatbot or a collection of disconnected automations.



Our vision is to build the AirUs Intelligence Platform: a secure, scalable and continuously improving intelligence layer that supports every major area of the business.



The platform should automate repetitive work, identify inefficiencies, predict problems, challenge existing processes and provide management with evidence-based recommendations.



Our long-term objective is to operate significantly more properties without increasing headcount at the same rate.



This is a long-term opportunity to help design and build an ambitious platform from the ground up.





The Role



We are looking for an experienced AI Systems Architect & AI Automation Engineer to work directly with the CEO.



This is a hands-on role combining:



Systems architecture

AI engineering

Workflow automation

Data integration

Browser automation

Business process improvement



You will not simply be given a list of automations to build.



You will be expected to understand business problems, challenge weak processes, recommend better solutions and build reliable systems that produce measurable results.



The platform will be developed in controlled phases, starting with the foundations and highest-value workflows before expanding across the wider business.





Our Vision



We want AI that:



Thinks critically

Identifies operational bottlenecks

Detects risks and anomalies

Predicts problems before they happen

Challenges inefficient processes

Automates repetitive work

Recommends practical improvements

Improves profitability and operational quality

Reduces unnecessary costs

Helps management make better decisions

Learns from previous decisions and outcomes



Instead of simply reporting:



Occupancy is 84%.



The system should be capable of explaining:



Occupancy is currently 84%, which is six percentage points below target. Four properties account for most of the shortfall. Reducing the minimum stay from three nights to two at those properties is projected to increase monthly NET profit by approximately £2,300.



Recommendations must be based on reliable data and should include assumptions, confidence levels, risks and approval requirements.





What We Intend to Build



The AirUs Intelligence Platform will eventually support:



Executive reporting

Finance and reconciliation

Property operations

Guest communications

Client communications

Cleaning and laundry management

Maintenance

Renovations and procurement

Recruitment

HR and training

Property and client onboarding

Listing creation

Revenue management

Growth and sales

Marketing

Compliance

Quality assurance

Business intelligence

Knowledge and decision management



We do not expect all of this to be built immediately. The successful candidate will help us prioritise and implement the platform systematically.





Key Responsibilities

Design the technical architecture of the AirUs Intelligence Platform

Translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions

Build advanced n8n workflows

Develop AI-assisted workflows and specialist AI agents

Build browser automations using Playwright where APIs are unavailable

Integrate business systems through APIs, webhooks and reusable connectors

Design PostgreSQL data models

Implement RAG and knowledge-retrieval systems where appropriate

Connect AI models securely to authorised business data

Build dashboards and executive reporting

Implement human approval processes for sensitive actions

Create error handling, retries, logging and alerting

Test workflows before production deployment

Monitor and improve existing automations

Protect the platform from unnecessary vendor dependency

Maintain clear technical documentation

Identify and quantify further automation opportunities

Challenge requests that are insecure, unreliable or unnecessarily complex

Architecture Principles



The platform must be:



Secure by design

Modular

Vendor independent

Well documented

Observable

Testable

Cost conscious

Easy to maintain

Capable of supporting future growth



External systems such as PMS platforms, accounting software and AI providers should connect through replaceable integrations rather than becoming embedded in the platform’s core business logic.





Required Technical Experience



You should have strong practical experience with most of the following:



n8n

OpenAI APIs

Anthropic Claude APIs

AI workflow or agent development

REST APIs

Webhooks

Playwright or equivalent browser automation

Python

JavaScript and/or TypeScript

PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database

Vector databases and RAG

Git and version control

Docker

Cloud or VPS deployment

Authentication and secrets management

Logging, monitoring and error handling

Business process automation



Experience with Langdock and Model Context Protocol is beneficial but not essential.





Relevant Integration Experience



Experience integrating any of the following would be valuable:



Property Management Systems

Airbnb



Stripe

QuickBooks

Google Workspace

Microsoft 365

WhatsApp Business

Ring

Minut

Canva

Social media platforms



Direct experience with short-term rentals is useful but not required.





Minimum Requirements



To be considered, you must:



Have at least two years of relevant commercial automation, software or AI engineering experience

Be able to demonstrate systems you personally designed or built

Have excellent written and spoken English at CEFR C1 level or above

Be comfortable working independently

Be proactive and commercially minded

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Understand that reliable automation requires testing, monitoring and maintenance

Be willing to document your work thoroughly

Be comfortable receiving and giving constructive challenge



Exceptional candidates with less experience may still be considered where they can demonstrate unusually strong technical ability and ownership.



The Person We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



Loves solving difficult business problems

Thinks beyond the task they have been given

Investigates the root cause before building a solution

Challenges inefficient or unnecessary processes

Builds scalable systems instead of fragile quick fixes

Understands the difference between a prototype and a production system

Takes security and data privacy seriously

Considers failure scenarios before deployment

Communicates technical subjects clearly

Takes ownership of outcomes

Continuously asks: “How can we make this better?”



If you prefer waiting for detailed instructions before taking action, this role is unlikely to suit you.





Application Instructions



Begin your application with the following code:



AirUsAI25^



Applications that do not begin with this exact code will not be considered.



Please answer every question below.



1. Previous system



Tell us about the most advanced AI automation, AI agent or integrated system you personally designed and built.



Explain:



The business problem

The architecture

The tools used

Your personal contribution

How it was tested

The measurable result

What you would improve now



2. First AirUs project



Based on this job description, what would be the first system or workflow you would build for AirUs and why?



Explain what information you would need before making the final decision.



3. Process improvement



Describe a business process you significantly improved using AI or automation.



What changed and what measurable benefit was achieved?



4. Architecture



How would you prevent a business from becoming dependent on one PMS, AI provider or automation developer?



5. Reliability



Describe an automation you built that failed or behaved unexpectedly.



What caused the failure, how did you resolve it and what safeguards did you introduce?



6. AI understanding



Explain the difference between:



A chatbot

An AI-assisted workflow

An AI agent

A deterministic automation



Give an appropriate business use case for each.



7. Experience ratings



Rate your experience from 1–10 and briefly justify each score:



n8n

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

Playwright or similar browser automation

Python

JavaScript or TypeScript

PostgreSQL

APIs and webhooks

Docker and deployment

RAG and vector databases



8. Difficult problem



Describe the most technically difficult problem you have solved and how you approached it.



9. Security



How would you securely manage production credentials, customer data and developer access for a system like this?



10. Previous work



Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, demonstrations or previous AI projects where available.



Clearly explain which parts you personally completed.





Why Join AirUs?



This is not another role building isolated automations from a predefined task list.



You will have the opportunity to help design and build an intelligence platform that could transform how an entire company operates.



You will work directly with the CEO, influence important architectural decisions and build systems that are used in real business operations.



We are looking for someone who wants long-term ownership of something meaningful and is excited by the challenge of turning an ambitious vision into a secure, reliable and commercially valuable platform.

*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.

This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.

Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.

Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines.

Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.

- 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

 or structured feedback workflows

The Role

This is not just a coding role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems using AI and automation.



You will help us build intelligent systems that don't just automate work but actively improve how the business operates every day.



Our Vision



We don't want AI that simply answers questions.



We want AI that:



Thinks critically.

Identifies operational bottlenecks.

Challenges inefficient processes.

Predicts problems before they happen.

Continuously suggests improvements.

Automates repetitive work.

Helps management make better decisions.

Improves profitability.

Reduces costs.

Helps us scale from 25 to 150+ managed properties without proportionally increasing headcount.



Ultimately, we want AI to become the intelligence layer of our company.

Finance & reconciliation

Operations

Revenue management

Marketing

Compliance

Instead of saying:

Responsibilities

Build dashboards and executive reporting.

Continuously improve existing workflows.

Identify opportunities for automation.

Challenge existing business processes.

Recommend new AI solutions as the company grows.

Required Skills

n8n

Langdock

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

AI agent development

Prompt engineering

Workflow automation

REST APIs

Webhooks

Browser automation (Playwright or similar)

Python

JavaScript and/or TypeScript

PostgreSQL or similar databases

Vector databases / RAG

Git

Cloud deployment

Business process automation

Nice to Have



Experience integrating systems such as:



Property Management Systems

Airbnb



Stripe

QuickBooks

Google Workspace

Microsoft 365

WhatsApp Business

Ring

Minut

Canva

Social media platforms

Minimum Requirements

Have a minimum of 1 year of commercial experience building AI systems or AI automations.

Have excellent written and spoken English (minimum CEFR C1 level).

Be comfortable working independently.

Be proactive and solution-focused.

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Be passionate about using AI to improve businesses rather than simply writing code.

The Type of Person We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Loves solving difficult business problems.

Thinks beyond the task they've been given.

Challenges inefficient processes.

Suggests better ways of working.

Builds scalable systems instead of quick fixes.

Enjoys learning new technologies.

Takes ownership of projects.

Is excited by building something completely new.



If you simply wait for instructions, this role probably isn't for you.



We want someone who constantly asks:



"How can we make this better?"



Important

AirUsAI25^

title: Content & Marketing Ops Executive
description:
FULL-TIME, REMOTE-BASED, WORK FROM HOME



Interested candidates, please submit your resume to Privacy Ninja at 
 look forward to welcoming a new member to our team!



Important Notes for Applicants

-> This is a full-time remote position. While the role is remote, the successful candidate is expected to work within Privacy Ninja’s standard working hours of 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Singapore Time).

-> Please apply only if you are able to commit to these working hours and the full-time nature of the role.

-> This position includes a 3-month probationary period. A separate probationary remuneration package will apply during this period.

-> All applications will go through an initial screening stage before interviews are scheduled. Candidates who are shortlisted for the interview stage are expected to come prepared to discuss their experience, and relevant past work, among others.

____________________________

ROLE PURPOSE:



The Content & Marketing Operations Executive is responsible for owning the day-to-day execution and operational quality of Privacy Ninja's marketing ecosystem.



This role ensures that websites, newsletters, social media, videos and marketing assets are executed accurately, consistently and on time. While strategic priorities are set by the Senior SEO Strategy & Content Operations Lead, this role is expected to take ownership of execution, proactively identify issues, recommend practical improvements and ensure work is completed to a consistently high standard.

_________________________

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Newsletter Operations

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational delivery of Privacy Ninja's recurring newsletter programme.

--> Assemble, QA, schedule and publish newsletters according to approved content plans and publishing calendars.

--> Support recurring newsletters including:

* PDPA Organisations

* MCST PDPA

* DPO-as-a-Service

* VAPT

* Phishing Awareness

--> Ensure all newsletters:

* display correctly across devices

* contain working links and CTAs

* follow approved formatting and branding

* are free from formatting or publishing errors

--> Identify missing content, broken links or inconsistencies before publication.

--> Escalate uncertainties relating to messaging or technical accuracy before newsletters are sent.



Accountability: You own the operational quality of every newsletter before it reaches our subscribers.



2. Website Operations & CMS Management

Responsibilities

--> Own the accurate publishing and maintenance of approved website content across Privacy Ninja's WordPress ecosystem.

--> Use WordPress and Elementor to:

* publish blog articles

* update webpages

* make basic layout adjustments

* update images

* maintain internal links

* update CTAs

* perform minor formatting corrections

--> Ensure published content matches approved versions.

--> Review pages after publishing to ensure:

* layouts remain consistent

* desktop and mobile views display correctly

* forms, buttons and navigation function properly

* no formatting or publishing issues exist

--> Identify and resolve simple website issues independently.

--> Escalate development-related issues where required.



Accountability: You own the quality and presentation of published website content. If something breaks during publishing, it is your responsibility to identify it before our visitors do.



3. Social Media Operations

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational delivery of Privacy Ninja's approved social media content.

--> Schedule and publish content across assigned platforms.

--> Prepare posts using approved copy, graphics and templates.

--> Coordinate publishing calendars with marketing campaigns.

--> Monitor scheduled content to ensure successful publication.

--> Escalate issues affecting publishing schedules or campaign quality.



Accountability: You ensure approved content reaches the right audience accurately, consistently and on schedule.



4. Video Content Operations

Responsibilities

--> Assemble short-form educational videos using approved scripts, templates and AI-assisted workflows.

--> Perform quality assurance on:

* captions

* branding

* formatting

* audio

* video completeness

--> Produce recurring educational content for:

* PDPA

* MCST

* VAPT

* Cyber Hygiene

--> Prepare reusable content libraries for future campaigns.

--> Support structured content planning by organising reusable source materials.



Accountability: You own the operational consistency and publishing readiness of all recurring video content.



5. Product & Service Knowledge

Responsibilities

--> Build and maintain a strong understanding of Privacy Ninja's services and solutions.

--> Maintain organised internal reference materials covering:

* products

* services

* FAQs

* differentiators

* positioning

--> Identify outdated or inconsistent information.

--> Coordinate updates with relevant stakeholders.



Accountability: You are expected to understand our business sufficiently to recognise incorrect, incomplete or inconsistent messaging before it reaches customers.



6. Marketing Asset Management

Responsibilities

--> Maintain organised libraries of approved:

* sales decks

* one-pagers

* capability statements

* marketing collateral

* website assets

--> Ensure stakeholders are using the latest approved versions.

--> Coordinate updates when messaging or service offerings change.

--> Support preparation of campaign assets where required.



Accountability: You own the organisation, accessibility and operational readiness of our marketing assets.



7. Brand & Graphic Execution

Responsibilities

--> Own the operational quality of marketing visuals across Privacy Ninja's digital channels.

--> Create and adapt graphics for newsletters, websites, social media, presentations and marketing collateral using approved templates, brand guidelines and AI-assisted design tools.

--> Use AI effectively by providing clear context, prompts and reference materials to generate visuals that align with Privacy Ninja's brand, messaging and quality standards.

--> Review and refine AI-generated graphics to ensure they are:

* visually professional

* brand consistent

* accurate

* appropriate for the intended audience

--> Maintain consistency across all marketing materials in terms of layout, typography, colour palette, spacing and overall presentation.

--> Recognise when design requirements exceed internal capability and coordinate with external designers where necessary.



Accountability: You are not expected to be a professional graphic designer. However, you are expected to exercise good visual judgement and leverage AI effectively to produce high-quality marketing assets that meet Privacy Ninja's brand standards. You should know how to provide AI with the right context, refine its output and recognise when specialist design expertise is required.



8. Operational Improvement & Ownership

Responsibilities

--> Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing workflows.

--> Recommend improvements to templates, SOPs and recurring processes.

--> Reduce repetitive manual work wherever practical.

--> Maintain organised documentation and operational checklists.

--> Escalate operational risks before they affect delivery.

--> Contribute ideas that improve execution quality, efficiency and consistency.



Accountability: You don't simply execute existing processes—you help improve them.

_______________________

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

--> 2–4 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, marketing coordination or similar roles.

--> Hands-on experience using WordPress and Elementor (or similar CMS platforms).

--> Experience managing recurring content calendars and publishing workflows.

--> Comfortable using AI-assisted productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Canva AI or similar tools.

--> Strong written English and attention to detail.

--> Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple recurring deliverables.

_________________________

PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

We're looking for someone who:

--> Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

--> Pays attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate, polished work.

--> Thinks proactively and identifies issues before they become problems.

--> Communicates clearly and escalates blockers early.

--> Is dependable, organised and follows through on commitments.

--> Learns quickly and continuously improves the way work is done.

--> Works well independently while collaborating effectively with others.

--> Embraces AI and technology to improve productivity and operational consistency.



______________________________

ABOUT PRIVACY NINJA

Privacy Ninja is a Singapore-based data protection and cybersecurity firm focused on making compliance and security practical for everyday businesses. Through services such as DPO-as-a-Service and vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), we help organisations navigate PDPA obligations, strengthen their security posture, and build sustainable compliance practices — without the enterprise-level complexity or cost.



IMPORTANT: At Privacy Ninja, we look for people who embody our Privacy Ninja C.A.R.E. Framework -

– Character, Adaptability, Relational Communication, and Expertise – as these guide how we work and grow together.

This means individuals with strong work ethic, who are approachable, not afraid to admit mistakes, and committed to continuous learning and self-improvement (Character); who are not resistant to adopting new technologies, tools, AI, and automations (Adaptability); capable of clear, empathetic communication with clients and teams (Relational Communication); and who bring deep professional knowledge in the required and relevant skillsets for the role (Expertise). These four pillars define the kind of professionals who thrive in our fast-paced, high-trust environment.



OUR PHILOSOPHY

At Privacy Ninja, technical skills are important, but ownership is non-negotiable.

We value professionals who communicate proactively, identify problems before they become business issues, escalate blockers early, and take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

If you're looking for a role where you'll simply execute instructions, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

If you enjoy solving problems, improving systems and taking ownership of meaningful work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (B2B)
description:
We are hiring one full-time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to call U.S. businesses during U.S. Eastern business hours. Most calls will be to home-service or local-service businesses such as roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, cleaning, contractor, and similar companies.



Your job is to make outbound calls, follow a script, ask simple qualifying questions, book qualified appointments or warm handoffs, and keep the CRM updated.



This is an outbound sales role, not customer support. This is not a beginner training role. You should already have 4+ years of real outbound calling or appointment-setting experience and be comfortable making high-volume calls, handling rejection, speaking clearly, and keeping accurate notes every day.



We provide the lead list, script, CRM/dialer, process notes, and feedback. You bring proven outbound calling skill, consistency, clear spoken English, coachability, and professional phone presence.



Schedule, Pay, And Benefits



- Full-time, 40 hours/week.

- Monday-Friday,
ET USA time.

- 1-hour lunch break at 1200 ET USA time.

- Base pay is 50,000 PHP/month, paid weekly in PHP through Wise or PayPal.

- Commission/bonus eligibility begins after 5 closed sales generated from your qualified appointments or handoffs, if call quality and CRM accuracy meet standards.

- Paid U.S. and Philippine holidays off.

- We honor 13th-month pay.

- 5 PTO days after 1 year.

- Stable full-time work for the right person.



Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to U.S. businesses during Eastern Time business hours.

- Follow scripts and improve based on feedback.

- Qualify businesses using simple criteria.

- Book qualified appointments or warm handoffs when there is interest.

- Update CRM records after every call.

- Track call outcomes, appointment results, and follow-up notes.

- Send short daily updates on calls made, results, blockers, and next steps.



Must Have



- 4+ years of relevant outbound cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, phone sales, SDR, or BDR experience. This is a hard floor.

- High-volume outbound calling experience to American businesses, business owners, or decision makers.

- Either 100+ sustained outbound calls/day or clear booked appointment, qualified lead, transfer, or sales outcome proof.

- Clear spoken English suitable for U.S. business calls. C1 or C2 English is required if your OnlineJobs profile lists English level.

- OnlineJobs ID Proof score of 70 or higher.

- CRM or dialer experience.

- Full-time availability Monday-Friday,
ET USA time.

- Quiet workspace, good headset, stable internet, and a backup internet/power plan.



Strong Plus



B2B/business-owner calling, contractors, home services, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, real estate, insurance, solar, finance, agency, SaaS, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive, Salesforce, RingCentral, Kixie, Ytel, or Aircall.



To Apply



To apply, please answer these 3 questions and send a clickable link with your voice reading the script below. Google Drive, Loom, Vocaroo, or a similar public link is fine.



Short, real answers are better than a long cover letter. If you do not know a metric, write `I do not know` instead of inventing one.



1. How many years of outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience do you have, and have you called U.S. businesses before?

2. In your most recent outbound calling role, what industries did you call, was it B2B/business-owner calling or consumer calling, and what were your normal calls/day, appointments/week, qualified leads/week, transfers/week, or sales/month?

3. Can you work Monday-Friday,
ET USA time, accept 50,000 PHP/month base pay paid weekly in PHP with commission/bonus eligibility after 5 sales, and what CRM/dialer, internet speed, backup internet/power, headset, and quiet workspace do you have?



Applications without the 3 answers and a clickable voice recording link may not be reviewed.



Voice Recording Prompt



Please record yourself reading this script naturally, like you are speaking to a business owner on the phone:



"Hi, this is [your name]. I am calling because we help local home-service businesses like roofing companies, HVAC contractors, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, and cleaning companies get more qualified leads and booked appointments.



I know you are probably busy, so I will be brief. Are you currently looking for more residential or commercial jobs in your service area?



If it makes sense, I would like to ask a few quick questions and see whether we may be able to help. If not, no problem at all."



Then answer these two questions in the same recording:



1. Tell us about your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

2. How would you respond if a business owner says, "I am not interested"?



We are listening for clear spoken English, neutral accent, confidence, pacing, professionalism, and whether you can sound natural on a business call.

title: TikTok + Instagram Growth Operator (Social Media Manager, Multi Account) | Full-Time | $500-$1,500+/mo USD
description:
Pay: guaranteed monthly base of $500 to $800 USD depending on experience, plus uncapped performance bonuses.

Proven multi-account operators start between $1000 and $1,500. Paid weekly.

Platforms: TikTok and Instagram, multiple accounts, 5 to 10 cloud phones controlled from your computer.

Schedule: full-time, 8+ hours per day, 7 days per week, fixed schedule on US hours.



We are an established, profitable company. We run a growing network of TikTok and Instagram accounts in one specific niche, and we go deep on it. We are hiring a full-time operator to run 5 to 10 cloud phones from a computer and make accounts grow fast. Anyone can post content. You are there to make accounts take off. You pick the right clips from our content library, you ride the right trends, you watch what competitor pages are doing, and you keep every account healthy and posting daily. We supply the content, the playbook, the cloud phones and full training. The judgment calls are yours.



We Only Hire Top Players



Let's be direct. We are not interested in average applicants, and most applications will not move forward. We want it that way. We would rather leave the seat empty than fill it with someone ordinary. We want A-players and nothing else, because we run A-systems and pay A-salaries. If you are genuinely good, this works completely in your favor. You get real responsibility fast, and we build the team around people who deliver, for the long term. We are a serious company with proven results over several years.



This Is Not a Posting Job



A poster uploads what they are told and logs it in a sheet. A marketer looks at 30 clips and knows which two can hit 500,000 views, and can tell you why. We are hiring the second one. You will follow our process, but inside that process you make real calls every day: which clips to run, which hook to use, which trend to jump on, and which account needs attention before a small problem turns into a dead one.



What Your Day Actually Looks Like



The role runs on 5 to 10 cloud phones every day, all controlled from your computer through our systems. We provide the software and the access. Account health comes first: anything flagged, anything with reach behaving strangely, gets handled before everything else. Then overnight numbers on both platforms, and a scan of the pages we track to see what is popping. From there it is the content library. Pick the clips you believe can break out, make light CapCut edits where needed (trims, text overlays, covers), post on schedule across all accounts, run engagement, log the numbers, and send a clean report. About twice a week, you flag something nobody asked you for. A format that is working for competitors. An account that needs a different angle. That is the job.



Two Kinds of People Get Hired



Either you have done this before. You have run multiple TikTok or Instagram accounts at the same time, whether agency work, 
 or theme pages, or multi-account setups. You know what account warm-up feels like, you have dealt with restrictions, and you have numbers you can show.



Or you have not, but you should have. No direct experience, but you have a marketing brain. You watch a For You page and understand why things go viral. You are sharp and you learn fast. We have full training, SOPs and a content library. We can teach the process. We cannot teach judgment or drive.



Be honest in the application about which one you are. We hire both. What we never hire is someone pretending experience they do not have.



What We Provide



Day one you get onboarding documents, step by step SOPs, a content library, the cloud phone setup, training calls, and a manager who answers. You will never be guessing what to do. The SOPs cover the process. What we hire you for is everything the SOPs cannot cover: judgment.



Formal scope: 5 to 10 accounts across TikTok and Instagram, run on cloud phones from your computer, end to end. Content selection from our library, light CapCut edits, posting, engagement, account health monitoring, daily reporting.



What You Need



8 hours minimum per day, 7 days per week. The accounts post every day, weekends included, so the operation runs daily too. The trade-off is stability: same fixed hours every day, so you can build your life around it, and the pay lands every week.

A fixed schedule on US hours. This is not flexible. If you are in the Philippines, expect an early morning start.

A solid computer (8GB+ RAM, SSD preferred) and fast, stable internet (50Mbps+ with a backup plan). That is the whole hardware list. The phones are cloud phones we provide, you control them on screen, so you do not need any phone of your own.

Strong written English. Captions, reports and daily communication all depend on it.

You can follow a detailed process exactly, and you know when something looks off and it is time to speak up instead of blindly executing.

You will own your set of accounts end to end. You report numbers daily, but nobody hands you a script for what to pick. Your accounts, your calls, your results.

What We Pay



Your base is guaranteed: $500 to $800 USD per month to start, set by experience. Proven multi-account operators start between $1000 and $1,500. On top of base, your pay grows on two tracks. Base raises as you take on more accounts, and uncapped performance bonuses tied to how your accounts actually perform: views, growth, account health. When an account you run starts printing views, you feel it in your pay. The range is open ended. Your output sets the ceiling.



One thing to understand: the base is there because everyone feels safer with a guaranteed floor. The real money is in performance. Operators who adapt to the workflow fast and take the craft seriously can realistically double or triple their base between bonuses and raises. If that sounds like you, apply. That is exactly who we built this pay structure for.



We pay weekly, every week, on schedule. The exact payment method is spelled out inside the application, and you confirm it works for you before any interview.



We are not price-shopping. The $500 floor exists for unproven beginners we train from zero, and nobody good stays at the floor for long.



Where This Can Go



Operator, then Senior Operator with more accounts and a higher base, then Team Lead where you train and run other operators. The training materials already exist, you would own them. And it does not stop at this department: people who prove they can run things get promoted into other parts of the company, with bigger scope and better pay. Several people on our current team started exactly where you would be starting. They stayed because the pay lands every week without fail and the role keeps growing.



We are scaling hard. The process, the system and the knowledge already exist and already work, we are hiring to run a working machine at higher volume. We only bring on people with the same ambition. For those people we think this is the best role of its kind on this board, and the paid trial week exists so you do not have to take our word for it.



Who Should NOT Apply



You want a list of tasks to execute and nothing more. This role requires opinions about which content will perform, and why.

Running 5 to 10 cloud phones' worth of accounts sounds stressful to you instead of interesting.

You cannot commit to 8+ hours per day, 7 days per week, on a fixed US-hours schedule.

You plan to run this alongside another real job or anything that takes serious hours.

You would use AI to write your application. We have read hundreds of AI-written applications. They all sound the same, and we reject them. Write short and specific, in your own words. A long polished essay is the fastest way to get skipped.

Slow computer, unstable internet, no backup plan for outages.

You are an average performer looking for a safe seat. We only move forward with top players.

How to Apply



There is one way in: the application form. Do not send us a message here, messages are not reviewed.







The form takes about 45 minutes for most people. No video, no assignments, just precise questions answered in your own words. We made it thorough on purpose, because the form is the first test of the job: whether you can follow instructions closely and still think for yourself. Some questions contain specific instructions inside them. Follow them exactly.



Partway through the form, we tell you exactly what the niche is and what the accounts promote. If it is not for you at that point, you can say so and stop there, no hard feelings.



What happens next: every completed application gets a yes or no decision within 5 business days. We reply either way. Shortlisted candidates get a paid trial week before any final decision.

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.
